name: eventbrite-mcp
description: Eventbrite for Claude — your tickets and orders, organizer data, and public event discovery

eventbrite_token.title: Eventbrite private token
eventbrite_token.description: Personal OAuth token from eventbrite.com/platform/api-keys (needed for account/organizer tools; discovery tools use the browser bridge instead)

ws_port.title: Bridge WebSocket port
ws_port.description: Optional: override the fetchproxy concentrator port (fleet default 37149). Leave blank to use it.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: Bridge bind interface (hosted only)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Optional. Bind interface for the bridge, a literal IP only (anything else is ignored); default 127.0.0.1. Keep on loopback — it exists for a hosted child in its own network namespace. Leave blank.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: Bridge identity directory (hosted only)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Optional. Where to store the long-term bridge identity keypair, an absolute path only (anything else is ignored); default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/. Exists for a host that runs a separate child per caller. Leave blank.

tools.name: eb_me
tools.description: Get the authenticated Eventbrite user's profile (id, name, primary email)

tools.name: eb_my_orders
tools.description: List the authenticated user's ticket orders (attendee side), with the event expanded

tools.name: eb_my_organizations
tools.description: List the organizations the authenticated user belongs to (organizer side)

tools.name: eb_org_events
tools.description: List an organization's events (as organizer), optionally filtered by status

tools.name: eb_org_attendees
tools.description: List attendees across an organization's events (organizer side)

tools.name: eb_org_orders
tools.description: List orders across an organization's events (organizer side)

tools.name: eb_org_venues
tools.description: List an organization's saved venues (name, address, geo)

tools.name: eb_org_discounts
tools.description: List an organization's discount and access codes, including their usage limits

tools.name: eb_org_ticket_groups
tools.description: List an organization's ticket groups (ticket classes bundled across events)

tools.name: eb_org_webhooks
tools.description: List an organization's registered webhooks and the actions they subscribe to

tools.name: eb_org_report
tools.description: Run an organization's sales or attendees report, optionally windowed by date

tools.name: eb_event
tools.description: Get an Eventbrite event by id (works for any public event, not just yours)

tools.name: eb_ticket_classes
tools.description: List an event's ticket classes (name, cost, free/paid, on-sale status)

tools.name: eb_event_description
tools.description: Get an event's full HTML description

tools.name: eb_reference
tools.description: List Eventbrite reference data: categories, subcategories, formats, timezones, countries or regions

tools.name: eb_event_attendees
tools.description: List a single event's attendees (organizer-side; requires access to that event)

tools.name: eb_event_attendee
tools.description: Get one attendee of an event by id (barcode, profile answers, check-in state)

tools.name: eb_event_orders
tools.description: List a single event's orders (organizer-side; requires access to that event)

tools.name: eb_ticket_class
tools.description: Get one ticket class of an event by id

tools.name: eb_event_questions
tools.description: List the registration questions an event asks its buyers

tools.name: eb_order
tools.description: Get a single order by id (the buyer-side record behind a ticket)

tools.name: eb_venue
tools.description: Get a venue by id (name, address, geo)

tools.name: eb_venue_events
tools.description: List the events held at a venue

tools.name: eb_organizer
tools.description: Get an organizer's public profile by id (name, description, logo, social links)

tools.name: eb_organizer_events
tools.description: List an organizer's events — the public way to see everything one organizer is running

tools.name: eb_series_events
tools.description: List the occurrences of a recurring event series

tools.name: eb_user
tools.description: Get a public user profile by id

tools.name: eb_resolve_place
tools.description: Resolve a location to Eventbrite's internal place id for eb_search_events

tools.name: eb_search_events
tools.description: Search public Eventbrite events (the consumer search absent from the documented API)

tools.name: eb_event_details
tools.description: Batch-fetch public event details by id (bearer token by default, browser bridge fallback when no token is configured)

tools.name: eb_healthcheck
tools.description: Verify EVENTBRITE_TOKEN (or, without one, the browser bridge) end-to-end; reports an error kind such as credential_rejected or edge_blocked
